fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Normalized UTC timestamp representing when the event occurred.
fields.justification: Needed to order events chronologically and correlate activity across Windows, Linux, and network sources.

source_mapping.network_json: timestamp for Suricata or start_time for PCAP summary

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Hostname of the system associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify affected assets and correlate events generated by the same host.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Normalized category identifying the telemetry source of the event.
fields.justification: Needed to distinguish Windows, Linux, firewall, Suricata, and PCAP telemetry during detection and triage.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level normalized category such as authentication, process, network, network alert, or network flow.
fields.justification: Needed by downstream detections and analyst filters to group related activity independently of the original log format.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized severity assigned to the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to prioritize suspicious activity and support severity-based filtering during triage.

fields.name: user
fields.description: User account associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to correlate account activity and investigate authentication or user-driven actions.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Process or program associated with the event when available.
fields.justification: Needed to investigate process execution and correlate endpoint behavior across events.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address associated with network activity when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify the origin of connections and correlate endpoint events with network telemetry.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address associated with network activity when available.
fields.justification: Needed to identify communication targets and correlate connections observed by different telemetry sources.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Original event message retained before normalization.
fields.justification: Needed to preserve evidence fidelity and allow analysts to verify normalized values against the original event.
